strings: m_c comes in to see r_c0, picking up some poppy seeds in the hope for some completely dream-free sleep.

m_c whimpers as {PRONOUN/m_c/subject} {VERB/m_c/wake/wakes} up, pressing {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} ears flat. It's bad enough that {PRONOUN/m_c/subject} hardly ever {VERB/m_c/sleep/sleeps}, now what little they do get is plagued with nightmares.
